honest_negative_reason: RDKit UFF force field lacks Pt (d-block metal) atom-type parameters; UFFTYPER logs 'Unrecognized atom type: Pt6+2' for every Pt atom. Energies are fallback terms, not physical. Conformers (3D coords) are valid for downstream Vina docking but should NOT be used as a real minimization metric. The m10 Vina Min Score ceiling improvement (WEAK_TO_STRONG §2.7) remains PROJECTED — full UFF-min x Vina pipeline requires a force field that includes d-block metal parameters (e.g. MACE-OFF23 or SMIRNOFF/OpenFF with d-block coverage, neither of which is in this venv).
